Feeling Those Boho Blues

Fall into the blue this season. There is nothing more iconic than denim, and nothing easier to transition from summer to fall in than a boho-style jean. The always-in look may be trending, but the style is really never ending. Save on the new blue looks that look good on you!

TRENDING SAVINGS

DEFINE YOUR STYLE FOR BACK TO SCHOOL

This school year is now starring YOU! Head back to the halls in the styles made to make you feel like you. The savings are so good, you can get all the looks from jeans and tees to sweatshirts and sneakers without the compromise. Now hit the books, because back-to-school confidence is secured.

JUNIORS & MENS SAVINGS

PAYING FULL PRICE ISN’T PRETTY

We love a head-to-toe touch up, especially when the deals are as good as ours. So, head to our beauty section to find the brands you won’t believe we have from makeup musts to skincare secrets and haircare have-to-haves! Our prices really are pretty… perfect.

Help Local Students!

Celebrating 10 years of partnership with AdoptAClassroom.org to help provide supplies for students in need. Round up your purchase at checkout to support schools in your community. $1 donations can provide a student with supplies; $5 donations can provide a whole classroom with supplies. 100% of donations go directly to AdoptAClassroom.org

¹ 10% Off Disclosures

For In-Store New Accounts – Discount may be limited by temporary credit limit. Valid one time only. Offer not valid on prior purchases, gift cards, or layaway. Employees excluded. For Online New Accounts – Discount may be limited by temporary credit limit. Offer will be received via email within 2 days of approval. Must have valid email address and U.S. mailing address. Discount and/or the value of a promotional item applied on a pro-rated basis to all qualifying items purchased; any applicable refunds will be in pro-rated amount.

² Offer is exclusive to Burlington Credit Card holders enrolled in the Burlington Credit Card Rewards program. This rewards program is provided by Burlington and its terms may change at any time. Click here for full Rewards Terms and Conditions.

³ Offer is available to Burlington Loyalty Program members. Click here for terms and conditions. Burlington Card holders only receive Loyalty benefits if also enrolled in the Loyalty Program. Card holders are automatically enrolled in the Loyalty Program if an email address is provided.

⁴ A soft inquiry is used to check your eligibility which will not affect your credit score.
